[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-h2[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Record past Pomodoros with x=[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Capture gains `x=<E>[!][=<X>]`, which records already-finished [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pomodoros in one step. Each token starts and closes a past session [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that ends at the current 5-minute block. Consecutive tokens stack [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]back to back. A token never overlaps history, except that `!` trims[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]an edge of an older closed row and warns. bob previews, completes, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and documents the token, and the Mac app renders it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]past_pomodoro_recording.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/past_pomodoro_recording.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-h2[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-h2/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]x= lexer, capture-parse contract, and grammar 12[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: claim `x=` as a new whole-item session token. This covers the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lexer, the PomodoroPast model, teaching errors, chain ownership, stack [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]numbering, editor and capture-parse output, and grammar 12. Execution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refuses the token until record lands.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pomodoro-name completion inside x=[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]complete: capture-complete offers Pomodoro names at the `<E>` name [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]positions of `x=`. It never offers the running session, and replacements[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stop at `!`, `=`, and `@`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record engine with explicit-entry close, placement, and output[bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]record[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]record: execute `x=` stacks. Compute windows, resolve targets, and close[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the explicit entry at C = min(end, now). File the row chronologically, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]carry links only when the close carries them, and add human and JSON [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]output. A strict guard refuses every overlap.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Whole-stack overlap guard and ! edge repair[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after record[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: replace the strict guard with the full per-token `!` rules. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Running sessions are protected, the whole stack is validated at once, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]erase and split are refused, and closed-row edges are trimmed with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]warnings. Pin the user's five examples end to end.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture docs, references, and help for x=[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after guard, complete[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: document recording a past Pomodoro in docs/capture.md and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]syntax, JSON, and compatibility references. Polish CLI help and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regenerate the generated pages.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture Record past work card[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]mac[dim] · [dim][/dim]after docs[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac: decode `pomodoro_past` in Bob Mac Capture and render one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chronological Record past work card per stack. Style the new spans, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-run the preview when the clock crosses a 5-minute boundary.[/#D7D7AF]
